name: Photo Trend Maker
summary: Turn one photo into an 80s snapshot, a claymation world, a photo booth strip and 22 more trending looks.

seo.title: AI Photo Trend Maker – 80s, Y2K, Claymation & More
seo.description: Upload one photo and pick a trending look: 80s flashback, Y2K digicam, claymation, photo booth strip and more. Download it as a 9:16, 2:3, 3:4 or square JPG.
intro: Upload a photo of yourself, a friend or a pet, pick one of 25 looks and choose a size. PiCraft redraws the photo as a faded 80s snapshot, a handmade clay figure, a black-and-white photo booth strip, a glossy toy head, a collectible figure in its box, a pop-up paper card, a scrapbook page or a seasonal portrait for Halloween, Thanksgiving, Christmas and New Year's Eve, and keeps the subject recognizable.
There is no prompt to write. The default size is a full-screen 9:16 vertical image, and you can switch to 2:3 for Pinterest, 3:4 for feed posts or a 1:1 square before you create.

fields.label: Your photo
fields.help: One clear, well-lit photo of a person, a pet or a scene. Only upload photos you own or have permission to use.

options.label: 80s Flashback
options.prompt: an authentic snapshot from the mid-1980s. Restyle the hair, clothes, accessories and surroundings with unmistakable 1980s fashion and interior details: bold shapes, bright accessories, layered textures. Shot on consumer film with direct on-camera flash, faded warm colors, visible grain and slight softness. Add a small orange-red date stamp in a lower corner, set to a date in 1985. No readable posters and no modern objects.

options.label: 70s Slide Portrait
options.prompt: a sun-faded candid portrait from an early-1970s slide film. Dress the subject in period clothing and an early-1970s hairstyle, and adjust the surroundings to match. Warm red-yellow color cast, slightly lifted blacks, fine film grain and a soft vignette, with a faint color shift in the shadows, as if projected from an old family slide.

options.label: Y2K Digital Camera
options.prompt: a casual snapshot from an early-2000s compact digital camera with on-camera flash. Dress the subject in period-correct clothing, accessories and a typical early-2000s hairstyle, and adapt the surroundings. Harsh direct flash, uneven exposure with slightly blown skin highlights, soft focus, faint digital noise in the shadows and light JPEG compression artifacts. Casual, slightly awkward framing. No date stamp.

options.label: Night Out Flash
options.prompt: a stylish night-out photo shot with a bright on-camera flash. Strong flash highlights on the subject, deep shadows and slight overexposure against a dim, moody city-night background. Keep real colors and textures, glossy skin highlights and fine film grain. Candid magazine feel with imperfect framing, a touch of motion and a natural expression.

options.label: Photo Booth Strip
options.prompt: a vintage photo booth print. Build a collage of three vertical black-and-white photo strips of four frames each, slightly overlapping and tilted at small angles. Keep the person's face, clothes and hairstyle consistent in every frame, with playful, surprised and laughing poses. A few frames are partly cropped or the person leans toward the lens, and if there is more than one person they swap places between frames. Harsh direct flash, very high contrast with crushed blacks and blown whites, heavy grain, thick black borders and light wear.

options.label: Claymation World
options.prompt: a handmade clay stop-motion scene. Rebuild the subject as a stylized character sculpted from matte modelling clay: simplified chunky forms, slightly exaggerated proportions, a big expressive face with simple sculpted eyes and brows, and hair made of thick sculpted clay strands. Keep the subject's identity, pose, clothing colors and the composition. The surface must be clearly handmade, with fingerprints, tool marks, uneven edges and small imperfections. Rebuild the surroundings as a tiny hand-built miniature set with simple sculpted props, lit like a small studio set with shallow depth of field. It must read instantly as a photographed physical clay model, not as a photograph with a texture filter and not as smooth CGI.

options.label: Felt Miniature
options.prompt: needle-felted wool art. Rebuild the subject and the scene as handmade needle-felted wool miniatures: simple rounded shapes, minimal facial detail with tiny bead-like eyes, and soft fuzzy fibers with clearly visible wool texture on every surface, including the background and props. A warm, slightly imperfect handmade feel. Plush felt figures in a tiny diorama, warm soft lighting and a charming stop-motion look. It must read instantly as a photographed physical felt craft, not as a photograph with a texture filter.

options.label: Bobblehead
options.prompt: a studio product photo of a cheap, mass-produced plastic bobblehead based on the person in the photo. Stay faithful to their identity, with a friendly bright smile and chunky molded plastic hair. The head is comically oversized, about ten times the volume of a tiny body, standing on a small black base. Simplified molded vinyl face with painted eyes and brows, visible paint edges, slight paint misalignment, faint mold seam lines, injection-molded texture, tiny scuffs and soft specular highlights. It must look like a photographed physical object, not CGI. The surroundings take their cue from the photo.

options.label: 3D Toy Avatar
options.prompt: a premium glossy 3D designer-toy render of the subject. Show a single floating head, never duplicated, cleanly cut under the jaw so the neck shows, fully inside the frame with comfortable margins. Soft vinyl collectible look: ultra-smooth simplified rounded volumes, strong glossy highlights on key areas, sculpted shiny stylized hair with a playful accessory, and oversized retro wrap-around sunglasses in bold coordinated colors. Strong studio lighting with clear highlights. Background: blue sky with soft clouds.

options.label: 16-bit Arcade Fighter
options.prompt: a retro 16-bit arcade fighting game screen. Redraw the person as a full-body pixel-art fighter in an expressive pose, keeping their recognizable hair, skin tone and outfit colors but redesigning the outfit as a bold, readable arcade character. Show the name PLAYER 1 above a health bar. Turn the surroundings into a detailed side-view fighting stage with layered pixel scenery, dramatic lighting and period-appropriate arcade interface elements. Authentic limited-palette pixel art with hard edges and no smooth vector polish.

options.label: Blueprint Poster
options.prompt: a single-subject blueprint poster of the main subject in the photo; if it is a person, draw them as a technical figure. Clean white technical line drawing on a deep cobalt-blue blueprint background with a subtle grid. Flat 2D schematic lines, orthographic outline views, construction guides, dimension ticks, arrows and a few minimal technical labels. Add two or three smaller detail views of the subject from other angles. Keep the layout balanced and uncluttered, with no shadows, no 3D shading, no lighting and no extra objects.

options.label: Fantasy Newspaper
options.prompt: a whimsical black-and-white vintage newspaper front page with the person as the central portrait, styled like an old engraved halftone photo. Surround it with large dramatic headlines, narrow columns and playful sub-headlines about a fantasy adventure starring them. High-contrast black ink on off-white paper with fine paper texture and classic serif type. Keep their face recognizable and the layout tight and editorial. Use short, simple words in the headlines so the spelling stays correct.

options.label: Marble Statue
options.prompt: a refined neoclassical Greek-style statue carved in white Carrara marble, based on the subject. If the photo shows a person, turn them into a heroic allegorical figure in a dynamic pose with flowing drapery, a confident stance and a serious expression, keeping their face structure recognizable. If it does not show a person, do not add one. Echo elements from the photo in the sculpture. Museum hall setting, photorealistic, medium depth of field, natural perspective, warm gallery lighting with dramatic, realistic shadows.

options.label: Halloween Costume Portrait
options.prompt: a spooky-fun Halloween costume portrait. Dress the subject in a polished, original costume that suits them, such as a witch, a vampire, a skeleton or a scarecrow; for a pet, use a small, simple costume such as a pumpkin outfit, a tiny witch hat or a cape. The makeup and props look handmade and playful. Do not add any person or pet that is not in the photo. Set the scene on a candlelit porch or in a misty autumn yard with glowing carved pumpkins, fallen leaves, soft fog and a deep purple dusk sky with warm orange light. Cinematic lighting with a warm orange glow on the face, rich purple shadows and a little film grain. Keep it fun and atmospheric, not gory or frightening: no blood and no wounds. Use only generic costumes, with no recognizable movie, game or cartoon characters and no readable text.

options.label: Thanksgiving Harvest Portrait
options.prompt: a cozy Thanksgiving harvest portrait painted as a warm storybook illustration in gouache and soft colored pencil. Show the subject at a long candlelit autumn dinner table or in a golden-hour harvest scene with pumpkins, squash, wheat, apples and fallen maple leaves, in rust, mustard, burnt orange and deep green. Dress the subject in cozy autumn clothes such as a knit sweater or a plaid scarf, keeping their hair color and the character of their expression. If the photo shows a pet, it sits at the table or beside the pumpkins. Do not add any person or pet that is not in the photo. Visible brush strokes and paper grain, soft warm light, gentle detail and a generous, welcoming mood. It must read as a hand-painted illustration, not as a photograph with a filter. Add no text, signs or banners, no brand names, and no costumes or stereotypes of any historical or cultural group.

options.label: Christmas Card Portrait
options.prompt: a classic Christmas card portrait shot in a cozy living room. Dress the subject in a chunky knit sweater or soft winter clothes in festive reds, creams and forest greens, and place them in front of a decorated Christmas tree with warm string lights softly out of focus, a few wrapped gifts, pine garland and a glowing fireplace. Warm, flattering window and firelight, shallow depth of field and a clean, balanced composition with some calm empty space near the top, as if left for a greeting. A natural, genuine expression and crisp professional photography. If the photo shows a pet, give it a small ribbon or a tiny knitted scarf. Do not add any person or pet that is not in the photo. Add no text, no lettering and no readable signs.

options.label: Vintage Christmas Snapshot
options.prompt: a family snapshot from Christmas morning in the late 1970s or early 1980s, shot on consumer film with direct on-camera flash. Restyle the hair, clothes and room with period details: a wool sweater or a flannel robe, a real tree with thick tinsel and large colored bulbs, wood-paneled walls, wrapping paper strewn across a shag carpet and a few opened gifts. Warm, slightly faded color with a red-orange cast, visible film grain, soft focus toward the edges and flash glare on skin and glass ornaments. Casual, candid framing. If the photo shows a pet, it sits among the wrapping paper. Do not add any person or pet that is not in the photo. No date stamp, no text and no readable labels or brand names.

options.label: Snow Globe
options.prompt: a photographed physical snow globe that holds a tiny sculpted figure of the subject. Show a single round glass snow globe on a wooden mantel, with the subject rebuilt as a small, simplified miniature inside it: a cozy winter outfit for a person, or a little scarf for a pet, standing in a tiny snowy village with pine trees and a small cottage on a sculpted base. Soft white flakes drift inside the glass, with realistic glass reflections and refraction, small curved highlights and a faint dust of glitter. Behind it, warm out-of-focus Christmas lights and a garland. Keep the subject's identity, colors and character of expression recognizable in miniature. Do not add any person or pet that is not in the photo. It must read as a real photographed object, not a digital filter. Show only one snow globe and add no text.

options.label: New Year's Eve Party Flash
options.prompt: a glamorous New Year's Eve party photo shot with a bright on-camera flash. Dress the subject in tasteful, modest sparkling party clothes in black and gold, with a glittering accessory such as a headband, a hat or a tiara, holding a sparkler or a noisemaker, in a dim room full of falling gold and silver confetti, streamers, sparklers and a mirror ball scattering small points of light. Strong flash highlights on the subject, deep shadows, glossy skin highlights, real colors and fine film grain, with a candid magazine feel and a happy, mid-celebration expression. Keep the subject's identity; a pet stays recognizable with a small party accessory. Do not add any person or pet that is not in the photo, and show no other people or hands. No drinks, glasses or bottles. No text, no numbers, no clocks and no readable signs.

options.label: Collectible Figure Box
options.prompt: a photographed collectible action figure of the subject, sealed in retail packaging. Show exactly one figure standing in a clear molded plastic blister on a printed cardboard backer card, as if on a toy-shop shelf. The figure is a glossy molded-plastic version of the subject with simplified, slightly stylized sculpting that keeps their face shape, hairstyle, skin tone and the colors of their outfit, with visible joint seams and a small round base. Two or three accessories that suit what the photo shows sit in their own molded compartments beside the figure, such as a camera, a mug, a book or a backpack; for a pet use a tiny bowl, a ball and a leash. The accessories carry no lettering, no logos and no brand marks. The card is bold and colorful with a simple graphic backdrop and one short invented name of at most two simple words in large block letters, with no tagline, no small print, no logos and no brand, studio or character names. Soft studio product lighting, a clean neutral background and gentle reflections on the plastic. Do not add any person or pet that is not in the photo.

options.label: Pop-up Paper Card
options.prompt: a photographed pop-up greeting card with the subject built from layered paper. Show one card standing half open on a plain table, with a paper-cut version of the subject and a simple scene rising from the fold in three to five stacked layers of colored cardstock: the subject as a simplified figure with clean scissor-cut edges in front, and paper trees, hills, clouds, furniture or flowers behind it. Soft shadows fall between the layers, with visible paper grain, small fold creases and slightly uneven hand-cut edges. Keep the subject recognizable through hair shape, skin tone, clothing colors and expression, simplified into flat paper shapes, and use a restrained palette of four to six colors taken from the photo. Soft side light and shallow depth of field, so it reads as a real handmade craft object and not a digital illustration. Do not add any person or pet that is not in the photo. Add no text, no lettering and no printed greeting.

options.label: Scrapbook Journal Page
options.prompt: a handmade scrapbook journal page photographed from above on a desk. The subject's photo is the hero: it is printed as a real photograph with a thin white border, slightly tilted and taped onto a sheet of cream, kraft or lined journal paper with strips of washi tape, with the face and the picture itself unchanged and crisp. Around it add hand-made details: torn paper scraps, a pressed flower or leaf, a few small star and heart stickers, a ticket stub, a paper clip, pencil doodles, arrows and small sketched sparkles, all in a soft faded palette that picks up the colors of the photo. Warm window light, subtle paper grain and small shadows under the tape and paper edges. Show only one copy of the photo and no other photographs. Do not add any person or pet that is not in the photo. The scribbles must be wordless: no readable text, no letters, no numbers, no dates and no brand names.

options.label: Mini Doodle Twin
options.prompt: a real photograph with one tiny hand-drawn twin of the subject added. The photo stays photographic and untouched, with real skin, hair, clothing and surroundings exactly as they are. One small ink-drawn character, about the size of a palm, sits on the subject's shoulder or on the edge of a nearby object and looks at them or at the camera. It is drawn with loose black ink lines and a few flat marker colors, simple and cute, with the same hair shape and outfit colors as the subject so it is clearly the same person in cartoon form. Add a few small doodle accents around it, such as sparkles, a tiny heart or short motion lines, in the same ink. It must read as a drawing placed into a real photo, not a 3D figure. For a pet, the twin is a tiny ink drawing of the same animal. Do not add any other person or pet. No speech bubbles, no captions and no readable text.

options.label: Instant Photo Pop-Out
options.prompt: an instant-photo breakout illusion. A real hand holds a single instant-film print with a white border and a wide bottom margin, in front of the real surroundings of the photo. Inside the print the subject appears as in the photo, and one of their arms and hands reaches out past the white border into the real world with strong 3D perspective, so the subject seems to step through the frame. The reaching hand is closest to the camera, slightly larger and sharper than the rest, and casts a small realistic shadow on the border and on the holding hand. Keep the subject's face, hairstyle and clothing colors consistent between the print and the reaching hand. Each hand has exactly five natural fingers. For a pet, a front paw reaches out of the frame instead of a hand. Realistic photographic light, a shallow depth of field and a believable print surface. Show only one print and only these two hands. Do not add any person or pet that is not in the photo. Add no text, no logos and no handwriting on the border.

options.label: Photo Sticker Sheet
options.prompt: a sheet of nine die-cut stickers of the subject on a plain pale paper background. Show the same subject nine times in a neat three-by-three grid, each sticker in a different pose and expression: laughing, surprised, sleepy, thinking, cheering, winking, blowing a kiss, giving a thumbs up and shrugging. Draw each one as a glossy sticker with a thick white die-cut border and a faint drop shadow, in a clean, polished, semi-realistic illustrated style with bold simple shapes. Keep the face shape, hairstyle, skin tone and clothing colors consistent in every sticker so they are clearly the same person. Space the stickers evenly, with none touching and none cropped. For a pet, show the same animal in nine cute poses. Do not add any person or pet that is not in the photo. Add no text, no captions, no speech bubbles and no logos.

options.prompt: a tall vertical 9:16 frame

options.prompt: a 2:3 portrait frame

options.prompt: a 3:4 portrait frame

options.prompt: a square frame

specs.heading: Photo Trend file specs
rows: 1080×1920 px, the default and the full-screen vertical shape
1000×1500 px, the shape Pinterest recommends for Pins
JPG, PNG or WebP, up to 12 MB
notes: The image is generated at the shape you pick and then cut to the exact pixel size, so a 9:16 design is composed for a tall frame rather than cropped from a square.
Pinterest recommends 2:3 for standard Pins and may cut off taller images in feeds. See the [Photo trends category](/categories/photo-trends) for how the sizes line up with the platforms.

steps.title: Upload a photo
steps.description: A clear, well-lit photo of a person, a pet or a scene.

steps.title: Pick a look and a size
steps.description: Choose from 25 looks, such as [80s Flashback](/create/photo-trend-maker/80s-flashback), [Claymation World](/create/photo-trend-maker/claymation) or the [Christmas Card Portrait](/create/photo-trend-maker/christmas-card).

steps.title: Download the JPG
steps.description: A finished image at the exact pixel size, ready to post.

faq.q: Do I need to write a prompt?
faq.a: No. You upload a photo, choose a look and choose a size. PiCraft writes the instructions for the AI, including how to keep the subject recognizable.

A sharp, evenly lit photo where the face or the pet is large and clearly visible. Windowlight selfies, portraits and pet photos work well. Heavily filtered, blurry, very dark or tiny-subject photos give weaker results.

faq.q: Will the result still look like me?
faq.a: The maker is built to keep your face shape, skin tone, age and hair color, but AI likeness is never exact. Looks that rebuild you as an object, such as the [bobblehead](/create/photo-trend-maker/bobblehead) or the [clay figure](/create/photo-trend-maker/claymation), keep the spirit more than the exact face. If a result is off, generate again.

Use 9:16 for full-screen vertical images, 2:3 for Pinterest Pins, 3:4 for portrait posts and 1:1 for squares. The size changes how the image is composed, so pick it before you create instead of cropping afterwards.

faq.q: Can I upload a photo of someone else?
faq.a: Only upload photos you own or have permission to use, and ask before you restyle a recognizable person. Do not upload photos of children unless you are their parent or guardian.

faq.q: What happens to the photo I upload?
faq.a: Your photo is sent to our AI provider to create the image and is not shown to other visitors. The Privacy Policy lists the providers we use and how long data is kept.

faq.q: Can I use the results commercially?
faq.a: Yes, for personal and commercial projects, as long as your input does not infringe anyone else's rights. Check trademarks, and get permission from any person who can be recognized in the photo before you publish a design.

faq.q: Why is the text in some looks wrong?
faq.a: The [80s flashback](/create/photo-trend-maker/80s-flashback) date stamp, the [arcade fighter](/create/photo-trend-maker/arcade-16bit), [blueprint](/create/photo-trend-maker/blueprint-poster) and [newspaper](/create/photo-trend-maker/fantasy-newspaper) looks can draw short words into the image. The [collectible figure box](/create/photo-trend-maker/collectible-figure-box) prints a short invented name on its card. AI can misspell words and invent small garbled lettering, so read the result and generate again if something is off.

faq.q: How many credits does a design cost?
faq.a: One credit per design, whichever look and size you choose. If a generation fails, the credit is returned automatically.

faq.q: What if I don't like the result?
faq.a: Generate again. Each attempt is a new design, so the same photo and look can give a different pose, background or expression.
